allOf.title: Handle
allOf.description: A unique username or organization name starting with @, like @my-org.

allOf.title: Extension Name
allOf.description: The name of an extension — lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g. my-skill).

allOf.title: Version
allOf.description: A semver version like 1.0.0. Ranges are not allowed here.

PackLockEntry.title: Pack Lock Entry
PackLockEntry.description: Pinned version info for an installed pack from a registry.

Lockfile.title: AXM Lockfile
Lockfile.description: Records the exact versions of all installed extensions so installs are reproducible.
